assertions.evidence: The root explicitly loaded the generated check-model-routing Skill.
The root transcript recorded exactly one task call and one RoutingProbe child session.
The root ran as cursor/default and selected the probe-only @routing_probe binding, which resolved to cursor/gpt-5.6-luna.
The probe role requested thinkingLevel=low while the root invocation explicitly requested --thinking medium.
The root waited for RoutingProbe and collected its terminal marker result.
The child JSONL recorded model_change=cursor/gpt-5.6-luna and session_init resolvedModel=cursor/gpt-5.6-luna with resolvedModelIsFallback=false.
The child JSONL recorded thinking_level_change=low, and task job metadata independently reported resolvedThinkingLevel=low.
The child read the assigned worker asset and returned ROUTING_MARKER=model-routing-ok.
Root tool-call events contain the worker path only inside the task assignment; the only read of worker.txt is attributed to the RoutingProbe child.
The root read assets/root.txt before and after delegation and observed ROOT_MARKER=model-routing-root-ok.
The external post-run Git status contained no tracked changes.

limitations: The concrete cursor/gpt-5.6-luna slug exists only in the target-specific probe overlay and evidence, not in the portable Skill or canonical role.

The root CLI invocation requested medium thinking, but the saved root session emitted thinking_level_change with a null value. The claim is limited to the independently observed per-worker low override, not resolved root-reasoning telemetry.
OMP remains overall D0 because its separate plugin-manager dry-run probe failed the D1 safety gate.
